profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Oakland, California that provides free youth development programs for young people ages 9 to 18 from under-resourced communities. Programs include competitive soccer coaching, academic support, transportation, mentorship, nutrition, and college and career counseling.

All profile fields and the neutral summary are supported by the cited sources.
